Where the extra x64 RSS went (15 min A/B, smaps + malloc_info + mallinfo per startup stage; 2 glibc arenas, 0 mmap chunks): live data, not arena fragmentation. B - A in use at start +4.1 MB: legacy validation of projectDir kept for the whole run (first start, adoption) 0.79 MB; ProjectModel Tag vector grown by doubling (TagModel 856 B, 1350 Tag -> capacity 2048) 0.6 MB + 850 extra Tag 0.7 MB; TagStore 0.31 MB; logic engine + glue 1.53 MB (rules 0.34, slots/bind 0.40, outputs 0.14, schedules 0.10 incl. a copy of each document); logic.json tree freed after start. Plus ~0.8 MB free-but-resident holes in the main heap from the ~1 MB JSON tree of GET /logic every 5 s.

Fixes: legacy validation and the project JSON trees (LoadedProject) released once used; model Tags shrink_to_fit; schedule documents dropped once compiled; GET /logic written block by block (statusText, same bytes). 15 min A/B: +5344 -> +4418 kB RSS; both sides 1.9-2.8 MB lower.

A first 1 h run with ccf56cec only (without statusText): +5063 kB RSS, +0.08 CPU points, scan p99 max 8.01 ms with 1 overrun (one spike, lastMs 13.85 ms; probably GET /logic building its 1 MB tree under the engine mutex, not proven): not counted.
